summary: Stone Point Credit Income Fund filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its Board of Trustees declared a monthly distribution of $0.21 per common share for the September 2026 period, payable to holders of record as of September 30, 2026, with payment on or about October 20, 2026. Distributions are paid in cash or reinvested under the Fund's distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is involved; this mirrors an ordinary dividend declaration, so the event carries no risk-arb angle.
